introduction: Select only responsibilities you actually perform. This preliminary matching guidance is supplied by the project team and is not a final eligibility or admissions decision.

programmes.title: Marketing Executive
programmes.summary: Campaign planning and delivery; digital and offline marketing; marketing content and materials; customer and competitor research; campaign performance monitoring; campaign evaluation and improvement; stakeholder collaboration; marketing project and event coordination; budget monitoring; CRM/CMS and marketing technology; compliance and quality; ownership of defined marketing activities.

programmes.title: Marketing Manager
programmes.summary: Marketing strategy development; integrated strategic marketing planning; strategic decision-making; senior stakeholder influence; marketing budget planning and investment management; return on investment; business case development; advanced customer and market analysis; KPI management; commercial growth opportunities; marketing risk management; cross-functional leadership; agency and supplier management; marketing technology and process improvement; strategic professional advice; strategic evaluation and continuous improvement.
responsibilities: marketing budget planning and investment management

programmes.title: Associate Project Manager
programmes.summary: Support project planning, coordination and delivery; develop and monitor project schedules and milestones; monitor budgets and resource allocations; identify and manage project risks and issues; communicate with stakeholders; prepare progress reports; support governance and change control; coordinate resources and quality activities; maintain documentation and compliance; participate in project reviews and continuous improvement.
responsibilities: Support project planning, coordination and delivery
develop and monitor project schedules and milestones
identify and manage project risks and issues
participate in project reviews and continuous improvement

programmes.title: Project Controls Professional
programmes.summary: Develop and oversee project and programme plans; establish and apply project controls and governance procedures; monitor budgets and conduct cost forecasting; analyse project risks and their impact on cost and schedules; manage schedules and baselines; analyse project performance and recommend decisions; evaluate changes to scope, costs, resources and timelines; advise senior stakeholders; improve project controls systems, processes and assurance.
responsibilities: Develop and oversee project and programme plans
establish and apply project controls and governance procedures
monitor budgets and conduct cost forecasting
analyse project risks and their impact on cost and schedules
analyse project performance and recommend decisions
evaluate changes to scope, costs, resources and timelines
improve project controls systems, processes and assurance

questions.title: Marketing Strategy and Decision-Making
questions.description: Which responsibilities do you currently have in setting or implementing marketing strategy?

answers.text: I carry out marketing activities based on strategies set by others.
I make tactical delivery decisions and recommend improvements to agreed marketing plans.
I contribute to developing marketing strategies and influence marketing priorities.
I lead or materially influence marketing strategy and strategic investment decisions.

questions.title: Campaign Planning and Delivery
questions.description: How are you involved in planning and delivering marketing activities?

answers.text: I organise assigned campaign tasks and schedules.
I coordinate campaigns across channels, deadlines and team members.
I develop integrated marketing plans for different audiences, services or channels.
I set strategic campaign priorities and determine the overall marketing approach.

questions.title: Marketing Budgets, Investment and ROI
questions.description: Which budget and investment responsibilities are part of your role?

answers.text: I record marketing expenditure and report spending information.
I monitor campaign spending against an agreed budget and escalate variances.
I prepare budget forecasts, evaluate ROI and recommend resource allocations.
I make or significantly influence marketing investment decisions and justify business cases.

questions.title: Market Research and Commercial Opportunities
questions.description: How do you use market and customer information in your work?

answers.text: I collect customer feedback and basic market information.
I analyse customer, competitor and campaign information to improve delivery.
I analyse wider market trends and recommend commercial or growth opportunities.
I lead market opportunity assessments and influence business growth strategy.

questions.title: Marketing Performance and KPIs
questions.description: What responsibilities do you have for measuring and improving marketing performance?

answers.text: I update campaign performance reports and dashboards.
I analyse campaign KPIs and recommend operational improvements.
I interpret performance across multiple initiatives and advise on marketing priorities.
I use KPIs, financial outcomes and ROI to influence strategic marketing decisions.

questions.title: Stakeholder Engagement and Leadership
questions.description: How do you collaborate with and influence stakeholders?

answers.text: I work with colleagues and suppliers to complete assigned marketing activities.
I coordinate campaign approvals, agency tasks and stakeholder communications.
I present marketing recommendations to senior stakeholders and influence decisions.
I lead cross-functional marketing initiatives and influence senior management priorities.

questions.title: Marketing Channels, Content and Technology
questions.description: What is your involvement in marketing content, channels and systems?

answers.text: I create or update marketing content using existing tools and guidelines.
I coordinate content calendars, marketing platforms and compliance checks.
I evaluate marketing channels, technology and processes and propose improvements.
I determine strategic channel approaches and lead improvements to marketing technology or processes.

questions.title: Marketing Projects, Events and Agencies
questions.description: What responsibilities do you have for marketing projects and external partners?

answers.text: I support marketing events and campaign logistics.
I coordinate deadlines, deliverables, suppliers and assigned campaign projects.
I oversee agency performance, deliverables and commercial expectations.
I lead strategic marketing programmes and make significant decisions about external partnerships.

questions.title: Marketing Risk and Continuous Improvement
questions.description: How do you manage marketing risks and improvements?

answers.text: I follow established quality, data-protection and marketing procedures.
I evaluate marketing activities and report compliance or delivery issues.
I assess marketing operational, reputational and commercial risks and recommend improvements.
I lead strategic marketing improvements and make risk-informed recommendations to senior decision-makers.

questions.title: Project Planning and Scheduling
questions.description: Which planning and scheduling activities are part of your role?

answers.text: I update assigned project tasks, deadlines and milestones.
I coordinate project plans, schedules, resources and deliverables.
I develop or review integrated schedules and analyse project baselines.
I oversee project or programme plans and use schedule assurance to influence major decisions.

questions.title: Project Controls and Governance
questions.description: What level of responsibility do you have for project controls and governance?

answers.text: I maintain project documents and governance records.
I support governance reviews, scope control and established project procedures.
I establish or improve project controls procedures, monitoring and assurance arrangements.
I oversee project controls frameworks and governance assurance across projects or programmes.

questions.title: Budgeting, Cost Management and Forecasting
questions.description: What cost and financial responsibilities do you perform?

answers.text: I record project expenditure and financial information.
I monitor budgets and identify spending variances within an agreed project plan.
I prepare cost forecasts, analyse variances and recommend corrective actions.
I lead or significantly influence cost-control decisions, forecasting and financial trade-offs.

questions.title: Project Risk and Issue Management
questions.description: How are you involved in managing project risks and issues?

answers.text: I update risk registers and report identified issues.
I assess assigned risks and coordinate agreed mitigation actions.
I evaluate how project risks could affect cost, schedules and delivery performance.
I oversee risk-based project controls and provide assurance or recommendations to management.

questions.title: Project Change Control
questions.description: What responsibilities do you have for assessing project changes?

answers.text: I record project change requests and update relevant documentation.
I coordinate change approvals and update project schedules and plans.
I analyse the potential cost, timeline, scope and resource impacts of changes.
I provide significant project controls recommendations that influence major change decisions.

questions.title: Project Performance Analysis and Reporting
questions.description: What role do you play in project performance reporting?

answers.text: I collect progress information and prepare routine project updates.
I analyse progress against project milestones and prepare reports.
I produce forecasts, analyse exceptions and recommend actions using project controls data.
I define performance reporting approaches and use project controls analysis to advise senior leaders.

questions.title: Stakeholder Engagement and Strategic Decision-Making
questions.description: How does your work influence project and programme decisions?

answers.text: I communicate progress and task information to project team members.
I coordinate stakeholder communications and escalate project delivery issues.
I advise project managers or senior stakeholders using cost, schedule and risk analysis.
I materially influence senior governance or strategic decisions through project controls recommendations.

questions.title: Resources, Quality and Documentation
questions.description: How are you involved in project resources, quality and documentation?

answers.text: I maintain project records, documentation and quality information.
I coordinate project resources, assigned activities and quality requirements.
I analyse resource constraints and their effects on project performance and forecasts.
I influence resource control standards, assurance processes and wider project delivery improvements.

questions.title: Project Controls Improvement and Lessons Learned
questions.description: What involvement do you have in improving project delivery or controls?

answers.text: I participate in project reviews and lessons-learned activities.
I implement agreed improvements to project delivery procedures.
I identify and recommend evidence-based improvements to project controls systems and reporting.
I lead or significantly influence improvements to project controls processes, methodology or governance.
